##### Project general facts

Sera 2 is a thoughtfully designed residential project that combines modern architectural aesthetics with community-focused living. Set within a prime location, it offers residents a harmonious environment where clean lines, contemporary facades, and lush landscaping create a sense of serenity and sophistication.

The project features a collection of elegant apartments and townhouses, each designed with spacious layouts and natural light in mind. Interiors are finished with high-quality materials and functional design, creating homes that balance style with everyday comfort. Expansive windows and open-plan layouts enhance the feeling of space, making every residence ideal for both families and individuals.

Residents of Sera 2 will enjoy a range of premium amenities that foster wellness and social connection. From swimming pools and fitness areas to landscaped parks, play zones, and community spaces, the project offers a lifestyle where relaxation, recreation, and togetherness are at the core.

##### Location description and benefits

Rashid Yachts & Marina is the new global destination for discerning yacht owners to experience Dubai’s buzzing scene in an elegant environment where beauty and luxury collide. Designed to encapsulate the ultimate modern waterfront architecture, it combines luxury residences and a full-service marina with an appealing mix of restaurants and shops.

The new Marina at Rashid Yachts & Marina offers convenient, hassle-free access to Dubai, accommodating 430 wet berths for yachts up to 100m long with a range of flexible berthing options, from a single night through to seasonal and annual stays. You will benefit from the Marina’s state-of-the-art facilities, an expert, multilingual marina team offering yacht assistance around the clock, and a host of amenities and services you will find at your disposal.

A luxurious residential haven with modern amenities, beautiful scenery, and access to exciting local hotspots, Rashid Yachts & Marina is the perfect place to relax and explore in proximity to some of Dubai’s most exciting attractions.
